HypeCut Architecture & Pipeline

Open-source AI viral clips auto-editor · kunalmhetre27-ui/hypecut
GitHub Repo ↗

HypeCut watches Twitch/YouTube stream chat (live IRC or VOD replay) for hype spikes (KEKW, CLIP IT, WASTED, 5 STARS), extracts a 30-second window (20s before, 10s after), aligns words with Whisper, selects the best 15–30s cut snapped to sentence edges, and renders 720×1280 9:16 vertical clips with a 2.5s hook card, title bar, word-by-word captions, punch-zoom, and chat pop-ups.

1. Chat Spike Detection Scans live IRC or VOD chat velocity & emote bursts using adjustable spike sensitivity (default 3.0×).
2. 30s Window + Whisper Extracts 20s pre-spike + 10s post-spike windows and generates word-level timestamps.
3. Best-Cut Scoring Combines chat hype + audio loudness + speech density, snapped cleanly to sentence boundaries.
4. 9:16 Bundle Output Produces clip_01.mp4, clip_01.md, clip_01.json, index.md & AGENT_BRIEF.md.
